 ('service_specialist','Мастер-консультант','Сервисная часть обращения'),
 ('lawyer','Юрист','Юридический анализ, суды, риски'),
 ('sales_director','РОП / руководитель','Согласование, контроль, аналитика'),
 ('dc_director','Директор ДЦ','Крупные выплаты, судебные риски'),

 ('admin','Администратор','Роли, справочники, настройки, AI-лимиты')

UPDATE cc_claims SET
 workflow_stage = COALESCE(NULLIF(workflow_stage,''), CASE
 WHEN status='closed' THEN 'closed'
 WHEN status='awaiting_legal' THEN 'analysis'
 WHEN status='awaiting_diagnostic' THEN 'collecting_info'
 WHEN status='in_approval' THEN 'approval'
 WHEN status='in_court' THEN 'settlement_or_court'
 ELSE 'registration' END),
 stage_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(stage_no,0), CASE
 WHEN status='closed' THEN 8
 WHEN status='awaiting_legal' THEN 3
 WHEN status='awaiting_diagnostic' THEN 2
 WHEN status='in_approval' THEN 5
 WHEN status='in_court' THEN 7
 ELSE 1 END),
 risk_score = COALESCE(NULLIF(risk_score,0), CASE WHEN amount_demanded > 500000 THEN 90 WHEN amount_demanded > 100000 THEN 70 ELSE 40 END),
 risk_level = COALESCE(NULLIF(risk_level,'unknown'), CASE WHEN amount_demanded > 500000 THEN 'critical' WHEN amount_demanded > 100000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END),
 responsible_role = COALESCE(responsible_role, 'quality_manager'),
 updated_at = now();

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "claim", "sql": "SELECT id, workflow_stage, stage_no FROM cc_claims WHERE incoming_number = ?", "params": ["${input.incoming_number}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "st", "sql": "SELECT CASE '${input.to_stage}' WHEN 'registration' THEN 1 WHEN 'collecting_info' THEN 2 WHEN 'analysis' THEN 3 WHEN 'routing' THEN 4 WHEN 'approval' THEN 5 WHEN 'decision' THEN 6 WHEN 'settlement_or_court' THEN 7 WHEN 'closed' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END AS stage_no"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE cc_claims SET workflow_stage='${input.to_stage}', stage_no=${st.stage_no}, updated_at=now(), status=CASE WHEN '${input.to_stage}'='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN '${input.to_stage}'='approval' THEN 'in_approval' WHEN '${input.to_stage}'='analysis' THEN 'awaiting_legal' WHEN '${input.to_stage}'='collecting_info' THEN 'awaiting_diagnostic' ELSE status END, closed_at=CASE WHEN '${input.to_stage}'='closed' THEN now() ELSE closed_at END WHERE id='${claim.id}'"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_stage_history (claim_id, from_stage, to_stage, stage_no, changed_by_role, note) VALUES ('${claim.id}', '${claim.workflow_stage}', '${input.to_stage}', ${st.stage_no}, '${input.changed_by_role}', '${input.note}')"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_notifications (channel, event_type, payload, claim_id, status) VALUES ('telegram', 'status_changed', 'Статус ${input.incoming_number} → ${input.to_stage}', '${claim.id}', 'queued')"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE cc_tasks SET status='done', completed_at=now() WHERE id='${input.task_id}'::uuid"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "newId", "sql": "SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS id"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_csat (id, client_label, dealer_center, department, score, comment_text, status) VALUES ('${newId.id}', '${input.client_label}', '${input.dealer_center}', '${input.department}', ${input.score}, '${input.comment_text}', 'new')"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_tasks (csat_id, title, role, priority, status) SELECT '${newId.id}', 'Разобрать низкую CSAT', 'quality_manager', 'high', 'open' WHERE ${input.score} < 5"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_tasks (csat_id, title, role, priority, status) SELECT '${newId.id}', 'Приоритетный алерт руководителю по CSAT 1-2', 'sales_director', 'critical', 'open' WHERE ${input.score} <= 2"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_tasks (csat_id, title, role, priority, status) SELECT '${newId.id}', 'Запросить причину и предложить звонок руководителя', 'sales_director', 'high', 'open' WHERE ${input.score} < 4"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_notifications (channel, event_type, payload, status) SELECT 'telegram', 'csat_low', 'Низкая CSAT ${input.score} / ${input.client_label}', 'queued' WHERE ${input.score} <= 2"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "csat_id": "${newId.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "claim", "sql": "SELECT id FROM cc_claims WHERE incoming_number = ?", "params": ["${input.incoming_number}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "newId", "sql": "SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS id"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_court_cases (id, claim_id, case_number, court_name, dispute_summary, claim_amount, legal_position, status, next_hearing_at, responsible_lawyer) VALUES ('${newId.id}', '${claim.id}', '${input.case_number}', '${input.court_name}', '${input.dispute_summary}', ${input.claim_amount}, '${input.legal_position}', 'opened', '${input.hearing_at}'::timestamp, '${input.responsible_lawyer}')"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_court_hearings (court_case_id, hearing_at) VALUES ('${newId.id}', '${input.hearing_at}'::timestamp)"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_calendar_events (event_type, title, role, claim_id, court_case_id, starts_at) VALUES ('hearing', 'Судебное заседание ${input.case_number}', 'lawyer', '${claim.id}', '${newId.id}', '${input.hearing_at}'::timestamp)"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE cc_claims SET workflow_stage='settlement_or_court', stage_no=7, status='in_court', updated_at=now() WHERE id='${claim.id}'"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_stage_history (claim_id, from_stage, to_stage, stage_no, changed_by_role, note) VALUES ('${claim.id}', 'decision', 'settlement_or_court', 7, 'lawyer', 'Создано судебное дело ${input.case_number}')"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_notifications (channel, event_type, payload, claim_id, status) VALUES ('telegram', 'hearing_reminder_7d', 'Напоминание о заседании ${input.case_number}', '${claim.id}', 'queued')"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "court_case_id": "${newId.id}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "claim", "sql": "SELECT id::text AS id, claim_type, category, amount_demanded::text AS amount_demanded, LEAST(99, GREATEST(10, CASE WHEN amount_demanded > 500000 THEN 40 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN claim_type IN ('pre_court','lawsuit') THEN 30 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN category IN ('mileage_fraud','hidden_defects_14days') THEN 25 ELSE 10 END))::text AS risk_score, CASE WHEN LEAST(99, GREATEST(10, CASE WHEN amount_demanded > 500000 THEN 40 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN claim_type IN ('pre_court','lawsuit') THEN 30 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN category IN ('mileage_fraud','hidden_defects_14days') THEN 25 ELSE 10 END)) >= 80 THEN 'critical' WHEN LEAST(99, GREATEST(10, CASE WHEN amount_demanded > 500000 THEN 40 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN claim_type IN ('pre_court','lawsuit') THEN 30 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN category IN ('mileage_fraud','hidden_defects_14days') THEN 25 ELSE 10 END)) >= 60 THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END AS risk_level, CASE WHEN claim_type IN ('pre_court','lawsuit') THEN 'lawyer' WHEN category IN ('breakdown_after_14','service_quality') THEN 'service_specialist' ELSE 'quality_manager' END AS routing_hint FROM cc_claims WHERE incoming_number = ?", "params": ["${input.incoming_number}"]}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "newId", "sql": "SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text AS id"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO cc_ai_analyses (id, claim_id, analysis_type, model_name, user_role, cost_rub, risk_score, risk_factors, law_refs, recommendations, routing_hint) VALUES (?::uuid, ?::uuid, 'claim_risk', 'stub-rules', ?, 0.15, ?::int, ?, ?, ?, ?)", "params": ["${newId.id}", "${claim.id}", "${input.user_role}", "${claim.risk_score}", "type=${claim.claim_type}; category=${claim.category}; amount=${claim.amount_demanded}", "ЗоЗПП; ГК РФ (ориентир, не юр.заключение)", "Проверить комплект документов; оценить SLA; маршрутизировать по роли ${claim.routing_hint}", "${claim.routing_hint}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE cc_claims SET risk_score=?::int, risk_level=?, updated_at=now() WHERE id=?::uuid", "params": ["${claim.risk_score}", "${claim.risk_level}", "${claim.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "analysis_id": "${newId.id}", "risk_score": "${claim.risk_score}", "risk_level": "${claim.risk_level}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "claim", "sql": "SELECT id FROM cc_claims WHERE incoming_number = ?", "params": ["${input.incoming_number}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE cc_documents SET status='received', file_ref='${input.file_ref}', version_no=version_no+1, updated_at=now() WHERE claim_id='${claim.id}' AND doc_code='${input.doc_code}'"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": ""}}]}

reports.title: Список претензий
reports.query: SELECT incoming_number, client_label, vehicle_brand || ' ' || vehicle_model AS vehicle, dealer_center, claim_type, category, status, workflow_stage, stage_no, risk_level, reason_text, amount_demanded, amount_spent, responsible_name, received_at::text AS received_at, sla_deadline::text AS sla_deadline, outcome FROM cc_claims ORDER BY received_at DESC

reports.title: Открытые задачи
reports.query: SELECT COALESCE(c.incoming_number, s.client_label, '—') AS ref, COALESCE(c.client_label, s.client_label, '') AS client_label, t.title, t.role, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at::text AS created_at FROM cc_tasks t LEFT JOIN cc_claims c ON c.id = t.claim_id LEFT JOIN cc_csat s ON s.id = t.csat_id WHERE t.status = 'open' ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.created_at

reports.title: KPI руководителя
reports.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc_claims WHERE status <> 'closed') AS open_claims, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_demanded),0) FROM cc_claims WHERE status <> 'closed') AS amount_at_risk, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc_claims WHERE status <> 'closed' AND sla_deadline < now()) AS overdue_sla, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc_claims WHERE risk_level IN ('high','critical') AND status <> 'closed') AS high_risk, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc_court_cases WHERE status <> 'closed') AS open_courts, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_spent),0) FROM cc_claims) AS total_spent, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(score)::numeric,2) FROM cc_csat) AS csat_avg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cc_csat WHERE score <= 2 AND received_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS low_csat_30d

reports.title: Просрочки SLA
reports.query: SELECT incoming_number, client_label, dealer_center, workflow_stage, risk_level, amount_demanded, responsible_name, sla_deadline::text AS sla_deadline, EXTRACT(DAY FROM now() - sla_deadline)::int AS days_overdue FROM cc_claims WHERE status <> 'closed' AND sla_deadline < now() ORDER BY sla_deadline

reports.title: Претензии по ДЦ
reports.query: SELECT dealer_center, COUNT(*) AS claims_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(amount_demanded),0) AS amount_sum FROM cc_claims GROUP BY dealer_center ORDER BY claims_cnt DESC

reports.title: CSAT оценки
reports.query: SELECT client_label, dealer_center, department, score, comment_text, status, received_at::text AS received_at FROM cc_csat ORDER BY received_at DESC

reports.title: Судебные дела
reports.query: SELECT cc.case_number, c.incoming_number, cc.court_name, cc.claim_amount, cc.status, cc.responsible_lawyer, cc.next_hearing_at::text AS next_hearing_at, cc.dispute_summary FROM cc_court_cases cc JOIN cc_claims c ON c.id = cc.claim_id ORDER BY cc.next_hearing_at NULLS LAST

reports.title: Календарь событий
reports.query: SELECT event_type, title, role, starts_at::text AS starts_at, ends_at::text AS ends_at FROM cc_calendar_events WHERE starts_at >= now() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY starts_at

reports.title: Недостающие документы
reports.query: SELECT c.incoming_number, c.client_label, d.doc_code, d.title, d.required, d.status FROM cc_documents d JOIN cc_claims c ON c.id = d.claim_id WHERE d.status = 'missing' AND c.status <> 'closed' ORDER BY d.required DESC, c.incoming_number

reports.title: Журнал AI
reports.query: SELECT a.created_at::text AS created_at, c.incoming_number, a.analysis_type, a.model_name, a.user_role, a.cost_rub, a.risk_score, a.routing_hint, a.recommendations FROM cc_ai_analyses a LEFT JOIN cc_claims c ON c.id = a.claim_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

reports.title: CC Debug
reports.query: SELECT id, val, created_at::text AS created_at FROM cc_debug ORDER BY id DESC

reports.title: Лента комментариев
reports.query: SELECT c.incoming_number, c.client_label, cm.author_role, COALESCE(cm.author_name,'') AS author_name, cm.visibility, cm.body, cm.created_at::text AS created_at FROM cc_comments cm JOIN cc_claims c ON c.id=cm.claim_id ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC

reports.title: Правила уведомлений
reports.query: SELECT rule_code, title, event_type, channel, COALESCE(target_role,'') AS target_role, enabled::text AS enabled, COALESCE(template_text,'') AS template_text FROM cc_notification_rules ORDER BY rule_code

reports.title: Итоги судебных дел
reports.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS cases_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(claim_amount),0) AS amount_sum, string_agg(case_number, ', ' ORDER BY case_number) AS case_numbers FROM cc_court_cases GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

reports.title: Планёрки CSAT
reports.query: SELECT meeting_at::text AS meeting_at, title, COALESCE(participants,'') AS participants, COALESCE(decisions,'') AS decisions, COALESCE(assignments,'') AS assignments, status FROM cc_csat_meetings ORDER BY meeting_at DESC

reports.title: Очередь уведомлений
reports.query: SELECT n.created_at::text AS created_at, n.event_type, n.channel, n.status, COALESCE(n.payload,'') AS payload, COALESCE(c.incoming_number,'') AS incoming_number FROM cc_notifications n LEFT JOIN cc_claims c ON c.id=n.claim_id ORDER BY n.created_at DESC

metadata.brief: Бриф CLAIMS CONTROL — P1: workflow претензий, документы, CSAT, Dashboard, AI, уведомления; P2: суды, календарь
